comparison.question: Does Buck2 restore the ExecuTorch portable runner on a clean worker?
comparison.timed_scope: Native command and registry startup after dependency preparation; registry shutdown is recorded separately. The bazel-remote store is transferred as a GitHub artifact outside timing. This screen does not compare end-to-end provider performance.
comparison.cache_scope: BoringCache uses a fresh case, series, sample and run tag. bazel-remote uses a fresh local store transferred to a new warm worker. Native local result state starts empty on each worker.

verification: Require the declared native command to succeed
Require declared outputs and successful output checks
Require native remote-hit evidence and the same output hashes on the warm worker
Require registry shutdown to complete successfully
